pick.name: Attio (Free)
pick.what: Modern, flexible data-model CRM with email/calendar sync
pick.why: Most generous free tier checked (3 seats, 50k records), API + Claude/MCP-friendly, custom objects suit B2C+B2B+services in one workspace
pick.free_limits: Free: 3 seats, 3 objects, 50,000 records, 1 email sync/user, 200 emails/mo; Plus USD 35/user/mo annual

alts.name: Twenty
alts.why: Best free-forever exit: self-host on a small always-free VM, REST/GraphQL + MCP server; cloud Pro USD 9/user/mo
alts.free_limits: Self-host free; cloud has a 30-day trial only
alts.license: AGPL-3.0 core with commercial parts (verify LICENSE)

alts.name: HubSpot Free CRM
alts.why: Wins if you want native Apollo/Cal.com sync and forms/landing pages in one; Starter USD 7-20/seat
alts.free_limits: Free: 2 users, 1,000 contacts, 1,000 other records, HubSpot branding

candidates.name: Twenty
candidates.verdict: Pick if you want open source / self-host and zero lock-in

candidates.name: HubSpot Free
candidates.verdict: Pick if native Apollo + Cal.com sync matters more than limits (1,000 contacts)

candidates.name: Zoho Bigin
candidates.verdict: Free: 1 user, 500 records, 1 pipeline; Express USD 7/user

candidates.name: Apollo built-in deals
candidates.verdict: Fine for prospecting state, weak as the system of record

candidates.name: Frappe CRM / Krayin
candidates.verdict: OSS self-host options (active releases Oct 2026), smaller ecosystems

decision: Attio's free tier comfortably holds a solo founder's whole pipeline and its API suits Claude-driven automation. Apollo has no native Attio sync (only Zapier/Stacksync), so push qualified Apollo replies into Attio via webhook or a Claude script. Switch to HubSpot Free if you'd rather have the native Apollo integration, or Twenty if you want self-hosted ownership.

verify.note: Attio Free confirmed: 3 seats, 3 objects, 50k records, 1 sync/user, 200 emails/mo, API included; Plus USD 35 annual / 44 monthly. Twenty alt confirmed: 30-day cloud trial only, AGPL + '@license Enterprise' files, SDK/CLI/UI MIT. HubSpot alt confirmed (2 users, 1,000 contacts, 1,000 other records). 'Apollo has no native Attio sync' not re-verified.
